title: Dashon neumorphic dashboard
lede: A Webflow dashboard experiment in which the frame, sidebar, cards, and bars all rise from one pale surface.
summary: Webflow analytics-dashboard experiment: pale gray-blue cards with paired shadows and orange progress bars.

creator.name: Viktoria Kosmovich (as credited on the page)

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear. The whole dashboard is one pale surface; cards, search field, icon buttons, and the Logout button rise with white and gray shadows, and progress tracks are pressed.

observed: A large raised frame on a pale gray-blue page holds a sidebar and a grid of cards in the same color.
Four “Total Earns 2056” cards and four larger panels are raised; the active “Dashboard” item in the sidebar is a raised bar.
The search field, bell, gear, and user buttons at the top are small raised squares and pills.
Three progress tracks under “Best Selling Categories” are pressed wells with orange gradient fills. “on” in the Dashon logo is orange; text is dark navy sans-serif.
interpretation: A dashboard with few controls, one of the uses the style suits. The footer says it was “recreated for experimental purposes”, so it is a demonstration, not a product.
Measured: shadows on 84 % of boxes (median offset 4.2 px, median blur 15 px, none hard), borders on 4 %, median radius 10 px.

images.alt: Dashon dashboard experiment: a pale gray-blue raised frame with a sidebar, four raised Total Earns cards, raised Revenue and Sales panels, and pressed progress tracks with orange fills.
